argv: from pathlib import Path; import os, stat; root=Path(os.environ['TEMP']); target=root/'native-symlink-capability-target'; link=root/'native-symlink-capability-link'; target.write_bytes(b'agent-assure-symlink-probe'); os.symlink(target, link); metadata=link.lstat(); assert stat.S_ISLNK(metadata.st_mode); assert metadata.st_file_attributes & stat.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT; assert link.read_bytes()==b'agent-assure-symlink-probe'; link.unlink(); target.unlink(); print('native file symlink capability: passed')
